intro.text: A book by Corvana that gathers the chants of the Vanrial, an order of artists on Roshar.

description.text: The Vanrial have sung these chants for generations without knowing what the words mean. They hold that the Heralds wrote the songs in the Dawnchant.

items.text: Jasnah Kholin left her copy with her uncle on the Shattered Plains. When Navani wrote down the words Dalinar spoke at the end of a vision, she found them matching a Vanrial chant in Jasnah's copy, showing the visions were not his own invention and opening a way to translate the songs and the Dawnchant.
